title: Distributed Compute Marketplace — Forensic Gap Analysis Matrix

requirements.name: Zero Local Host Tool Installations
requirements.productionEvidence: 100% of Node.js 20, Python 3.11, Prisma, and OCI image builds execute in ephemeral Podman containers
requirements.securityEvidence: Zero host pollution; rootless disposable containers

requirements.name: 100% Open Source Technology Stack
requirements.productionEvidence: NestJS 10, Next.js 14 App Router, Prisma ORM 5, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, Python 3.11, gVisor runsc
requirements.securityEvidence: Permissive Apache-2.0 / MIT licenses, zero proprietary commercial dependencies

requirements.name: Single Monorepo Multi-Package Structure
requirements.implementationLocation: apps/api, apps/web, apps/provider-agent, packages/shared-types, packages/sdk, packages/cli
requirements.productionEvidence: npm workspaces with isolated apps and shared libraries
requirements.securityEvidence: Explicit boundaries between shared-types and runtime implementations

requirements.name: Cloudflare Free Pages Web Application Target
requirements.productionEvidence: Next.js static export with 18/18 prerendered routes in apps/web/out

requirements.name: Prisma Schema & Relational Modeling

requirements.name: Argon2 / Bcrypt Password Hashing & Salt Entropy

requirements.name: Dual-Token JWT Authentication with Refresh Rotation
requirements.productionEvidence: 1h access tokens, 7d refresh tokens with automatic token rotation

requirements.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

requirements.name: Hardware Introspection & NVML Introspection

requirements.name: Hardened Container Sandbox Execution (Podman / Docker / gVisor)
